Accessibility for everyone.

Our commitment to identifying, removing and preventing barriers so everyone can access our products, services and information.

Our commitment

RFBT Distribution Centre Inc. is committed to an accessible and inclusive environment across our distribution, warehousing, logistics and administrative operations. We strive to respect the dignity, independence, integration and equal opportunity of persons with disabilities.

Our commitment extends to employees, job applicants, delivery personnel, suppliers, contractors, business customers and visitors.

Accessible services & facilities

We will work with you to identify reasonable arrangements when standard receiving, pickup, delivery or visitor procedures create an accessibility barrier.

Service animals and support persons are welcome in applicable areas, subject to legal and safety requirements. Some warehouse and loading areas are restricted because of moving equipment and other hazards. We will work with you to identify an appropriate alternative where needed.

Accessible formats & communication supports

Accessible formats of our public documents and communication supports are available upon request, in a timely manner and at no additional cost. We will consult with you to determine an appropriate format or support.

For questions, assistance or an accessible-format request, email accessibility@rfbtdistributioncentre.com or call 905-479-0989.

Website & digital experience

We are working to improve navigation, readability and compatibility with assistive technologies, and to address identified barriers in our website and digital communications.

Some services, including online ordering, are provided through third-party platforms. If you have difficulty accessing a digital service, please contact us so we can help arrange an alternative way to access information or assistance.

Employment accessibility

Accommodation is available upon request throughout recruitment and selection. We are committed to accessible workplace information and individualized accommodation and emergency response arrangements where required.

Employees seeking workplace accommodation may also contact Human Resources or their designated management representative.

Temporary disruptions

If a disruption affects accessible facilities or services, we will provide notice as soon as reasonably possible. Where applicable, notices will explain the reason, anticipated duration and available alternatives.

Need assistance?

Questions, feedback or requests for accessible formats are welcome.

Feedback & accessibility questions

If you encounter a barrier or have a question about accessibility, email accessibility@rfbtdistributioncentre.com. We aim to acknowledge accessibility-related inquiries within 5–7 business days. Our feedback process is available in accessible formats or with communication supports upon request.

You can also call 905-479-0989 or write to Accessibility Inquiries, RFBT Distribution Centre, 80 Bentley Street, Markham, ON L3R 3L2, Canada.
